cohort: This study included 790 surviving infants with a gestational age <30 weeks who survived to 36 weeks postmenstrual age, divided into groups according to BPD severity.
finding: Increased BPD severity is associated with an increased risk of neurodevelopmental impairment at both 2 and 5 years corrected age, and while NDI incidence increased over time, the strength of the association with BPD severity remained consistent.
